• Soot
– Pollutant, carcinogen, contributes to glacial melting
• Smoke point (SP) measures sooting propensity.
– Luminous flame length before smoke emission.
– Correlates w/ soot volume fraction and radiative loss fraction.
• Prediction: Non-buoyant flames don’t have smoke points.
– Residence time would not scale with flow rate.
• Smoke ppoints found aboard pparabolic aircraft and sppace shuttle.
• It is believed that residence time influences smoking behavior.
